item.description: Shifting Australia's dependence away from US technology companies towards resilience will require significant investments, experts are warning.

item.title: ABC News: Six more women accuse Russell Brand of sexual offences
item.description: Convicted rapist Russell Brand is facing fresh allegations of predatory behaviour and committing sexual offences, after six new accusers went public on Friday.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: UK police launch investigation into David Walliams
item.description: London's Metropolitan Police have launched an investigation into actor and comedian David Walliams, after the entertainer was accused of serious sexual offences earlier this week.

item.title: ABC News: Spectacular try helps England to Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup glory
item.description: England has been crowned Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup champion for a third time, defeating France 50-38 as Australia finished its campaign with a comprehensive victory in the third-place play-off.

item.title: ABC News: Floreat gunman's daughter condemns 'entitled' father intent on control
item.description: Ariel Bombara delivers a devastatingly powerful apology for her father's actions at an inquest into the 2024 shooting murders of family friends Jennifer and Gretl Petelczyc.

item.title: ABC News: Prisoner who bolted from brother's funeral caught after months on the run
item.description: Orijol Rukaj was in handcuffs when he fled the funeral in Melbourne after helping to carry the casket. Seven months later, he's been found almost 3,800km away.

item.title: ABC News: Teens committed to trial over alleged murder of Sunshine Coast soccer coach
item.description: Two Sunshine Coast teenage boys charged with fatally stabbing a man in his home last year have been committed to face a jury trial in the Brisbane Supreme Court.

item.title: ABC News: Accused killer allegedly used phone while he said he was sleeping, jury hears
item.description: A computer analyst told the jury Robert Crawford's phone was unlocked five times between 1:09am and 3:20am on the night his wife died.

item.title: ABC News: Australia's next fast bowling star blows England away on ODI debut
item.description: Mahli Beardman becomes just the second Australian to snare a five-for in their ODI debut as England is skittled for 131 in Perth.

item.title: ABC News: Man who burned shoebox of tax records fined for resulting bushfire
item.description: A Tasmanian man who lit a fire to burn tax documents in a shoebox, which then spread and destroyed two homes, has been convicted and fined.

item.title: ABC News: Hung jury in trial of man accused of Busselton 'love triangle' murder
item.description: A jury is discharged in the murder trial of James Anthony Sorgiovanni, 29, who had been accused of the stabbing murder of a woman whose body was found stuffed in a wardrobe.

item.title: ABC News: How the Microsoft outage is affecting Australia
item.description: Australians wake to empty inboxes due to an issue with Microsoft's products, leading to cancelled appointments, grounded flights and School of Air's closure.

item.title: ABC News: Teen sentenced for 'vicious' attack on woman sleeping rough
item.description: An teenager has been sentenced for a nine-minute attack on a woman who was sleeping rough near a public library in Adelaide's inner south last year.

item.title: ABC News: 'Embarrassing' state of Indigenous rights must be addressed, UN expert says
item.description: A UN special rapporteur says Indigenous rights are "unsafe" in the hands of states and territories and warns that the failure to protect them is damaging Australia's reputation.

item.title: ABC News: Ex-NSW Liberal MP guilty of raping 13yo boy
item.description: Rory Amon, the former member for Pittwater, stood trial in the NSW Supreme Court this week with the jury delivering its verdict on Friday.

item.title: ABC News: Tasmanian premier apologises for 'outcome' of Christmas post
item.description: Tasmania's premier said he is "sorry for the outcome" his comments about a school's end-of-year celebrations have had, but that he stands by his "expectations" when it comes to Christmas.

item.title: ABC News: Locusts wreaking havoc across South Australia's pastoral land
item.description: Producers across South Australia's Mid North and Flinders Ranges are reporting significant locust outbreaks.

item.title: ABC News: ‘They absolutely destroy a cherry’: Lorikeets wipe out Perth orchard
item.description: A tiny flock of rainbow lorikeets introduced to WA in 1968 has bred into an almighty problem — with their latest attack taking out all the cherries at a Perth Hills Orchard.
